_doc: Stage-3 rig and skinning inputs for Valdris (tools/blender/gf_hero/s3_valdris_run.py). Metres, Blender axes (Z up, faces -Y, +X = his left). Hand-edited; rerun python tools/blender/gf_hero/s3_valdris_run.py after a change. body + parts follow the shared s3_skin.py format (Brax: art/characters/brax/stage3_skin.json); every armour, beard and cloth part uses mode 'hook', weighted by tools/blender/gf_hero/s3_valdris_skin.py from the 'rig' block below.

hook._doc: s3_skin.py (shared) imports this module: after_armature() installs the driven x_ helpers, part_weights() weights every part in mode 'hook', after_bind() links the colossus_cannon GLB onto weapon_R (PREVIEW, not exported).

body._doc: BODY = the fitted MakeHuman hm08 under-suit (mail, padding, the face and the gauntlet glove). seed = MakeHuman CC0 game_engine weights (exact per vertex, s3_mh_seed.py); heat_mix blends Blender's bone heat into the seed per region (0 = seed only).

heat_mix._doc: Torso and limbs half seed, half heat (as Brax). The glove hands keep the seed (heat is unreliable on fingers, and the lames hide them); the head keeps most of the seed (face loops).

twist._doc: share of a limb class moved onto its twist bone along the bone (t = 0 at the bone head, 1 at the tail).

body._doc_fixes: As Brax (shared s3_skin.py): rest_relax first (positions only), then after the seed / heat mix and the twist split: joint_blend, smooth, spatial_smooth; then 4 influences, normalised.

rest_relax.name: extra_loops_onto_the_profile
rest_relax._doc: the stage-2 knee / elbow / wrist loops sit on edge chords; each loop vertex moves onto the 4-point subdivision curve of its edge loop

parts._doc: Every separate part is weighted by the hook (s3_valdris_skin.part_weights) from the rig block.

rig._doc: Valdris's per-hero x_ extras (docs/art/GF_HERO_SKELETON.md section 2: leaf chains prefixed x_, deform, never keyed by shared clips). Two kinds: DRIVEN helpers (a Copy Rotation of a core bone at a partial influence, or a driver; Blender evaluates them and the stage-5 exporter bakes them into every clip, as it bakes the twist bones) and CLOTH chains (cape, loincloth, braids: at rest in shared clips, sprung in the engine or posed by his unique clips; s3_valdris_cloth.py poses them clear of the body for the validation poses). The helper bones are built with the rest orientation of the core bone they follow (same direction and roll), so a local-to-local Copy Rotation turns them by the same axis.

pauldron._doc: x_pauldron_L/R, parent clavicle, the upperarm's rest orientation, head at the pauldron's inner hinge (by the neck, under the cap). A Transformation constraint turns it by `follow` x the upper arm's ELEVATION only (the Z part of its swing with the twist about the arm removed, clamped upward): raising the arm lifts the pauldron's outer end about the hinge, the upright plate by the head barely moves, and a forward swing or a lowered arm leaves the pauldron where it is (a full Copy Rotation also swung it forward into the beard: reports/stage3/limits.json). The lower arm lame rides the upper arm.
pauldron._doc_follow: 0.6 and the hinge by the neck were chosen by the sweep in reports/stage3/limits.json (shoulder): follow 0 / 0.35 / 0.5 / 0.65 / 0.8 / 1.0 and hinges at |x| 0.25 / 0.32 / 0.37. A side raise stays clean to about 35 deg; beyond ~45 deg the forearm meets the pauldron's outer lame whatever the follow, and a higher follow or an outer hinge swings the upright plate into the head and the braids. The helpers' constraints are additive (mix AFTER), so a unique clip (the Bulwark Slam leap) may key x_pauldron on top.

elbow._doc: x_elbow_L/R, parent upperarm, the lowerarm's rest orientation, head at the elbow joint: the elbow ring and the couter turn `follow` of the elbow bend. Left 0.5 (the cap sits between the arm segments). Right 1.0: the colossus_cannon is rigid on the forearm and its rear cuff ends 5 cm in front of the elbow, so a half-turning couter cut into the cuff at any bend (limits.json 'cannon'); on the forearm it moves with it.

knee._doc: x_knee_L/R, parent thigh, the shin's rest orientation, head at the knee joint: the poleyn (knee cop) and the glowing knee smile turn half the knee bend.

tasset._doc: x_tasset_L/R, parent pelvis, the thigh's rest orientation, head at the tasset's hinge on the belt: both tasset lames swing with this fraction of the thigh, so the lifted thigh does not cut through them.
tasset._doc_follow: 0.25 from the hip sweep (reports/stage3/limits.json 'hip') and the poses: with the torso upright a higher follow keeps the thigh plate from sliding under the tasset (0.5-0.65 clean to 45 deg), but in the braced, leaning poses (Siege Stance, lunge, squat) it swings the upper tasset up into the anvil's underside. Measured on the poses: brace 207 new clipping vertices at 0.5, 171 at 0.25, 157 at 0; stance poses (cannon aim, guard) 103 / 69 at 0.5, 107 / 67 at 0.25, 126 / 85 at 0.

fauld._doc: x_fauld_01, parent pelvis, from the top of fauld lame 3 to the fauld point: lames 3 and 4 swing forward with the forward-most thigh (a driver: max of the two thighs' flexion, never backward).

cape._doc: x_cape_{R2,R1,C,L1,L2}_01..05, parent spine_03: 5 chains at u = -1, -1/2, 0, 1/2, 1 across the cape's rows (stage2_parts.json cape.rows, x = u half_width, y on the cape's mid-surface), joints at joints_z. Weights: a vertex at (u, z) blends linearly between its two nearest chains and, along a chain, between the bones either side of its height (hat functions centred on each bone's middle); the top row is pinned to spine_03 (the cape hangs under the pauldrons from the collar line). The collar is rigid on spine_03.

loin._doc: x_loin_{R,C,L}_01..03, parent pelvis: 3 chains at u = -1, 0, 1 across the loincloth (stage2_parts.json loin), joints at joints_z; the same blend as the cape, the top row pinned to pelvis at the belt.

braids._doc: x_beard_{1..5}_01..02, parent head (1 = his right, x -0.14): _01 from the braid root to between plait lobes 2 and 3, _02 from there to the bottom of the steel cap. Lobes 1-2 ride _01, lobes 3-4, the ring and the cap ride _02 (rigid per piece).

beard._doc: The beard block, the locks and the moustache are hair on the head. The block's lowest band (the bib in front of the gorget) blends toward the neck, so a nod folds it instead of driving it through the gorget: head 100 % above z_head, down to bib_head at z_bib. Locks are rigid, one row each (the block's weights at the lock root).

pieces._doc: Armour piece name (stage-2 gf_piece -> reports/stage2/parts.json piece_table) -> bone, or {bone: share} for a blended rigid row. A piece is always rigid: every vertex of a piece carries the same row. <S> = L or R. Pieces not listed keep the stage-2 suggestion (MakeHuman names mapped to GF_Hero_v1).
pieces._doc_sabaton: The ankle cuff and the instep lame (toe lame 1) ride the SHIN: the greave and the shin plate sink into them, and the ankle sweep (limits.json 'ankle') measured the fewest cuts that way - clean to +20 deg of dorsiflexion (9 vertices), where on the foot they took 64, and a half-turning helper 38. The instep lame slides over the foot shell instead (lames of one boot).

rig._doc_constraints: Every helper constraint mixes AFTER the bone's own local rotation (additive): shared clips leave the helpers at rest and the constraint does the work; a unique clip may key a helper and the follow is added on top.
